title: BPW-2026-0550
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0550
STOP NOTICE – KARCHER ENVIRONMENTAL, INC.
Karcher Environmental, Inc., is transmitting a Stop Notice in the amount of $12,160, for labor and materials to preform abatement work for PCN3, Inc in connection with the Hollywood Sanitation Yard.
(C-203047, Communication No. 122751 - Filed October 12, 2026)
summary: Karcher Environmental has filed a $12,160 stop notice claiming labor and materials for abatement work at the Hollywood Sanitation Yard.
